$comment: Public repositories for the quiet benchmark (Track B2). Sparse paths keep clones small. CSS and SCSS (through postcss-scss).

repos.name: radix-themes
repos.notes: Token-driven CSS with --space-N custom properties. Expected to infer its own scale.

repos.name: mantine
repos.notes: CSS Modules. Spacing tokens are --mantine-spacing-*, which the default spacing pattern does not match; a fallback here is a token-discovery to-do.

repos.name: primer-react
repos.notes: CSS Modules using --base-size-N tokens. Same token-discovery caveat as Mantine.

repos.name: liveblocks-react-ui
repos.notes: Already consumes stylelint-plugin-logical-css through a shared config; a realistic embed target.

repos.name: shadcn-ui
repos.notes: Tailwind v4 with @theme in globals.css plus TSX class strings; exercises the Tailwind side of the audit.

repos.name: open-props
repos.notes: A token library, not a component library. Sizes are --size-N, so the spacing pattern will miss them; included to measure the cost of that gap.

repos.name: mittwald-flow
repos.notes: SCSS-first design system that already runs stylelint-plugin-logical-css.

repos.name: bootstrap
repos.notes: SCSS. Spacing comes from the $spacer map, not custom properties, so inference is expected to fall back.

repos.name: primer-css
repos.notes: SCSS. Spacing tokens arrive from @primer/primitives at build time.

repos.name: penpot
repos.notes: SCSS modules next to ClojureScript components. Already consumes stylelint-plugin-logical-css.

repos.name: mastodon
repos.notes: SCSS. Consumes stylelint-plugin-logical-css through its shared config.

repos.name: gutenberg-components
repos.notes: Mixed SCSS and CSS; the WordPress spacing scale is $grid-unit-*, so inference is expected to fall back.

repos.name: gitlab-ui
repos.notes: SCSS plus Vue templates. GitLab publishes @gitlab/stylelint-config, an embed target.

repos.name: pico
repos.notes: SCSS. Spacing derived from a $spacing variable.

repos.name: bulma
repos.notes: SCSS. Bulma v1 exposes --bulma-* custom properties; spacing is mostly Sass variables.

repos.name: spectrum-css
repos.notes: Plain CSS driven entirely by --spectrum-* tokens; a strong test of whether the token pattern is too narrow.

repos.name: uswds
repos.notes: SCSS with a units() function for spacing; raw px values are rare by design.

repos.name: carbon-styles
repos.notes: SCSS. Spacing through $spacing-NN tokens and the spacing() function.

repos.name: salesforce-lightning
repos.notes: SCSS. Spacing through $spacing-* design tokens.

repos.name: wp-calypso-components
repos.notes: SCSS. Consumes stylelint-plugin-logical-css at repo level.

repos.name: govuk-frontend
repos.notes: GOV.UK Frontend: Sass with govuk-spacing() functions; expects partial visibility.

repos.name: nhsuk-frontend
repos.notes: NHS.UK frontend: Sass spacing functions derived from GOV.UK.

repos.name: element-plus
repos.notes: Element Plus theme-chalk: SCSS with getCssVar() mixins.

repos.name: foundation-sites
repos.notes: Foundation for Sites: rem-calc() based Sass.

repos.name: tabler
repos.notes: Tabler: Bootstrap-derived SCSS.

repos.name: coreui
repos.notes: CoreUI: Bootstrap-derived SCSS with $spacer.

repos.name: patternfly
repos.notes: PatternFly: SCSS with --pf-t--global--spacer--* tokens.

repos.name: cloudscape-components
repos.notes: AWS Cloudscape: SCSS modules with awsui.$space-* tokens; test files excluded by noise rules.

repos.name: angular-material
repos.notes: Angular Material: SCSS with token maps.

repos.name: ionic-core
repos.notes: Ionic core components: SCSS per component.

repos.name: daisyui
repos.notes: daisyUI: plain CSS component library on Tailwind.

repos.name: mozilla-protocol
repos.notes: Mozilla Protocol: SCSS with $spacing-* variables.

repos.name: tachyons
repos.notes: Tachyons: utility CSS on a fixed spacing scale.

repos.name: pure
repos.notes: Pure CSS: small plain-CSS modules.

repos.name: forem
repos.notes: Forem (dev.to): SCSS with --su-* spacing tokens.

repos.name: discourse
repos.notes: Discourse: large SCSS codebase.

repos.name: ghost-admin
repos.notes: Ghost admin (Ember) plain CSS plus the Shade design system (Tailwind class strings).

repos.name: excalidraw
repos.notes: Excalidraw: SCSS with --space-factor tokens.

repos.name: docusaurus-theme-classic
repos.notes: Docusaurus classic theme: CSS modules with --ifm-* tokens.

repos.name: metabase
repos.notes: Metabase: CSS modules and Mantine-based UI.

repos.name: mattermost-webapp
repos.notes: Mattermost web app: SCSS.

repos.name: zulip
repos.notes: Zulip web: plain CSS with PostCSS.

repos.name: directus-app
repos.notes: Directus app: SCSS design tokens.

repos.name: n8n-design-system
repos.notes: n8n design system: SCSS with --spacing-* tokens.

repos.name: semi-design
repos.notes: Semi Design: SCSS per component with $spacing-* variables.

repos.name: vitepress-theme
repos.notes: VitePress default theme: plain CSS with --vp-* tokens. Maintainer (vuejs/vitepress#5423): no spacing scale, none planned; measured against the fallback for information only.

repos.name: starlight
repos.notes: Astro Starlight: plain CSS with --sl-* tokens.

repos.name: utrecht
repos.notes: NL Design System Utrecht: plain CSS with --utrecht-* tokens.

repos.name: grafana
repos.notes: Grafana: legacy SCSS.

repos.name: calcom
repos.notes: Cal.com: Tailwind class strings with a small CSS layer.

repos.name: skeleton
repos.notes: Skeleton: Tailwind-based CSS with --spacing tokens.

repos.name: adminlte
repos.notes: AdminLTE: Bootstrap-derived SCSS.

repos.name: vscode-base-ui
repos.notes: VS Code base UI widgets: plain CSS.

repos.name: materialize
repos.notes: Materialize (community fork): SCSS.

repos.name: hashicorp-design-system
repos.notes: HashiCorp Design System: SCSS with --token-* custom properties from the tokens package.

repos.name: fundamental-styles
repos.notes: SAP Fundamental Styles (Fiori): SCSS with --sapContent_* and --fdSpacing tokens.

repos.name: ui5-webcomponents
repos.notes: UI5 Web Components: CSS per component with --sapUiSpacing tokens; base theme parameters in a separate package.
